ambiguity_summary.interpretation: Operational finite-perturbation gate failure, not proof of exactly zero physical sensitivity; all new-light references are unconverged.

limitations: All L1/L2 sensitivity values remain provisional because their references fail convergence.
Sparse maps show only246 actual probe pixels; no interpolation or new rendering.
Conditional one-view RGB rank is not seven-parameter material identifiability.
No independent-tape variance or full128-view coverage estimate.

next_proposed_experiment.purpose: Separate integration error from persistent weak roughness/orientation responses without changing material or lighting.
next_proposed_experiment.reference_proposal: Independent fixed midpoint solid-angle hemisphere grids 256x256 and512x512; same physical additive kernel, shadow backend, positions/normals and image-formation conventions.
next_proposed_experiment.scope_exclusions: No additional light/material factors, full images,128-view generation, model or optimizer execution.
next_proposed_experiment.success_thresholds: Retain abs RGB .003 / relative L2 .002 and original local response criteria; no promotion of this failed pilot.
